name: movie_altair_isi_oblate
label: Movie: Altair's oblateness with the three ISI trucks in a triangle at 650 nm, two nights (the first intensity-interferometric stellar shape)
notes: Altair is 24 % oblate (Monnier et al. 2007: 3.67 x 2.96 mas, equator at PA 28 deg). The equilateral triangle gives three position angles 60 deg apart every block; the second night is rotated by 30 deg so six angles are sampled. The Fisher matrix on (theta_major, q) with the orientation held fixed gives sigma(q) per night.
Expected: ~22 sigma fringe detection per night, sigma(q) 0.07 after one night and ~0.05 after two (q - 1 = 0.24 at ~5 sigma). Gravity darkening is not modelled.
